name: git_set_base
description: Record or advance the run's base commit: the point reviewers diff against with git_changes_since_base. With no ref, the current HEAD becomes the base; pass ref (a branch, tag, or commit) to pin the base elsewhere. Record the base when a run starts; you may also advance it after a review round completes, so the next round's reviewers see only the changes made since. It records run bookkeeping and never changes the repository. Orchestrator-only.

detailed: Records or advances the base commit that reviewers diff against.
friendly: Set the base commit for reviews.
whimsical: Draw a line in the sand.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is recording the run's base commit

ref.description: Optional commit, branch, or tag to use as the base. Defaults to HEAD when omitted.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
